# @ndigo/locks

Distributed locks with fencing tokens for Node.js — the single-executor primitive behind multi-node @scheduled and cluster work

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `likeLockDriver` — Structural type guard for LockDriver — used where an entry or option is declared as an unknown collaborator and must be verified.
- `likeLockDriverAware` — Tests whether a value looks like lock-driver-aware state.
- `AsLockDriverAware` — Mixes lock-driver awareness into a base class.
- `LockAcquireOptions` *(type)* — Options for acquiring a lock.
- `LockDriver` *(type)* — The lock backend contract: lease-based, fencing-enabled, crash-self-healing. Acquisition is **non-blocking** — waiting policies belong to the caller (`@schedul…
- `LockDriverAware` *(type)* — Marks an object that can receive a LockDriver.
- `LockHandle` *(type)* — A held (or previously held) lease. The token is checked by the backend on every mutation, so a handle whose token lost the lease fails loudly rather than corru…
- `InProcessLockDriver` — The in-process LockDriver. See the module doc for the shared-table semantics; InProcessLockDriver.destroy releases only the leases this instance acquired.
- `InProcessLockDriverOptions` *(type)* — Options for constructing InProcessLockDriver.
- `LOCK_DRIVER` — Token for the application context's shared LockDriver entry — the `@scheduled({ lock })` runner resolves the driver through it when no driver was passed to the…
